summary: Darwin M. Lubugan is a Software Engineer | .NET Full Stack Developer based in Batangas, Philippines. He has approximately three years of professional software engineering experience since October 2023, building enterprise applications, automating business processes, and integrating REST APIs using C#, ASP.NET Core, SQL Server, PowerShell, Python, and Microsoft Azure. He is currently a Software Developer (Part-time) at NOUS AV IT Solutions (March 2026–Present). Previously, he was a Junior Network and System Administrator at Advani Group of Companies (November 2025–September 25, 2026) and a Software Engineer at Elyon Global Technologies Asia Inc. (October 2023–October 2025).

experience.summary: Build full-stack web applications and business systems for clients, from requirements gathering through delivery.
highlights: Developed a travel agency website and booking management system with purchase order functionality.
Built a timekeeping and payroll system to automate attendance and payroll processing.
Developed full-stack web applications using PHP, MySQL, Apache, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
Gathered client requirements and translated business needs into software solutions.

experience.company: Advani Group of Companies (Nyne Beauty Inc.)
experience.summary: Built internal tools and automations while supporting users, infrastructure, and business-critical applications. Partnered with teams to identify automation opportunities and reduce repetitive work.
highlights: Provided administration and application support for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, troubleshooting ERP issues and improving system reliability.
Developed PowerShell and Python scripts to automate Shopify product data alignment, deduplication, and barcode generation for POS upload, reducing a multi-week manual process to under one hour.
Developed a PHP and MySQL timekeeping system to fully replace Sprout, eliminating manual timesheets, removing third-party licensing fees, and improving payroll accuracy.
Collaborated with teams to identify automation opportunities, reducing repetitive tasks by approximately 70%.
Troubleshot Windows / macOS, network, and system issues; provided hardware and software support, installation, and end-user assistance.
Administered Active Directory user access, maintained servers and Linux environments, and supported Hyper-V and Proxmox virtualization.
Performed routine backups, maintained IT asset records, and supported equipment inventory tracking.
Built a C#/.NET ticketing system for internal requests and tracked issues in Azure DevOps.
Built Python automation for pfSense backups and used Whisper AI and Python to convert training transcripts into structured documentation.

experience.summary: Built automation features and responsive web applications for internal and client projects.

Delivered a scalable solution to handle high transaction volumes with real-time accuracy.
Built responsive web applications with Vue.js and reusable frontend components, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver internal business solutions.
